hypothesis: The built-in templates, with no game knowledge, die before 5:00 on the Nightmare Daily, and the log shows which damage sources and which minutes do it.
test: Play the templates as they are; change nothing. This is the baseline every later run compares with.
learnings: Baseline templates live far past 5:00 on this daily seed; damage is hot oil and bosses, not crowd.

hypothesis: Taking every chest and shrine in reach makes Tibo stronger faster than it costs in health.
test: planner.state tells the planner to favour chests and charge spots over gems and evading whenever they are within reach, and to pick the highest-damage card.
learnings: E21 partial look; 17-18-06 opened many chests and reached 17:14 with five evolutions. 17-20-20 opened about 32 chests and lived 15:03 with five evolutions by 8:16.

hypothesis: Favouring food, evading, and health and armor cards carries a weak build further than the baseline.
test: planner.state tells the planner to evade whenever enemies are close, eat food under 70% health, and pick health and armor first.

hypothesis: Planning every pick around one evolution, and saving chests until it is ready, beats picking for kill speed now.
test: planner.state names one weapon and its catalyst from the encyclopedia and tells the planner to take only those until the recipe is ready.
learnings: E21 saw Taproot at 2:19; 17-18-06 evolved five weapons without a single-recipe directive. 17-20-20 did the same by 8:16.

hypothesis: Exploring for chests and spots beats collecting xp gems.
test: planner.state favours explore goals over gems; knobs.exploreDistance 600.
learnings: E26 ran exploreDistance 600. Chests were opened from 1:08, and gems goals still ran for long stretches after 4:06 and around 10:14 and 14:09. The gems-versus-explore question is still open.

hypothesis: Not every spot that charges helps: some (a Beetle Nest wakes an elite) cost more than they give.
test: Send Tibo to every kind of spot it meets once, and read the log around each for health, level and enemies after.
learnings: Beetle Nest visits in E21 and 17-03-58. 17-20-20 charged nests at 0:26, 0:32, 0:57 and 3:09 for a few hp.

hypothesis: The planner follows a directive written into planner.state: its picks and goals change when the directive does.
test: Write one plain directive into planner.state and count how many picks and goals in the log agree with it.
outcome: E21: 0 evade, 8 chest starts once listed.
learnings: Directive works when chests/food exist; useless before listing. 17-20-20 again: 0 evade goals, chest opens once listed, food under 70%.

hypothesis: Asking the action model less often (a higher extraDamage) costs little health, because the game's forecast already rules out the worst moves.
test: knobs.extraDamage 0.08 against the baseline 0.02; compare health lost per minute.
learnings: E21 showed forecast-free steps costing hp under chargers. 17-20-20's largest hits (ice-imp 87 and 114, mandoline 64 and 82) were forecast at no damage on the goal direction, so a higher extraDamage still auto-walks them.

hypothesis: When a boss first appears, evading away from it loses less health than going for a chest or gems near it.
test: planner.state evade on boss appear; compare to E1 amusing/grater cases.
learnings: 17-27-39 kept explore through amusing at 2:00; lost hp before first chest. 17-20-20 kept the chest or explore goal through amusing at 2:00 and Colorado Queen at 3:03; neither boss is on the outcome list.

hypothesis: A weapon that hits all around Tibo without needing a direction (Steam Vent) is a better first weapon on nightmare than whatever card looks strongest.
test: planner.state names Steam Vent first.

hypothesis: Taking Rotten Spud on nightmare ends the run sooner, because the curse brings harder enemies before its evolutions pay off.
test: planner.state take Rotten Spud first.

hypothesis: Telling the action model to leave hot oil, and telling the planner not to evade while no enemy is within 60 and no boss is close, cuts hot-oil damage well below the baseline 274 and still lives past 5:00.
test: action.hurt/useful penalize burn; planner.goal chest over evade when enemies_near 0. Daily only.

hypothesis: A chest Tibo is already opening fails because stand-still is ruled out when staying forecasts more than extraDamage, and offering that step fixes failed opens.
test: Raise extraDamage and praise standing still on charging chest unless die/boss contact.
learnings: E21 chests often opened after step-off; 17-18-06 same pattern. 17-20-20 stepped off at 1:38 and 3:12-3:24 while 0.4 to 0.7 charged; one chest failed at 1:19 and several later opens still completed.

hypothesis: boss:ketchup-kraken and boss:compost-titan are the daily post-freezer killers.
test: Read id/name rows on daily E1.
outcome: Names matched ids; killing blow not in log.
learnings: Ids and spawn order settled on that seed.

hypothesis: The baseline's rises of about 25 to 30 hp with no food goal are a repeating heal on daily.
test: List +10 hp jumps without food on daily.

hypothesis: A completed food goal heals about 30 hp unless a boss hit lands in the same seconds.
test: Record food goal hp on daily.
learnings: 17-20-20 world food at 12:38 healed +31 (131 to 162). The 14:37 food ended at +7 with ice-imp 23.1 on the same stretch.

hypothesis: Grater Golem is a cheap boss minute on gems.
test: Record hp lost first 20s after Grater on daily.

hypothesis: Once charging a spot, switching to a second copy wastes the channel.
test: Planner keeps same spot until done.
learnings: E21 swapped chest goals but still opened. 17-20-20 swapped among listed chests at 1:19-1:31 and still opened the cluster by 1:43.

hypothesis: Under built-in templates, nightmare open world matches daily evade-then-gems and hazard-heavy damage.
test: No changes; nightmare world baseline.
learnings: Open world baseline evades, no gems; trash not hazards on that seed.

hypothesis: On nightmare open world, forecast-free steps still lose 2+ hp often.
test: Count no-damage forecast with hp_lost>=2.
outcome: Multiple rows before 3:00 on two seeds.
learnings: Charger and crowd ticks missing from forecast. 17-20-20 adds page walks of 34, 64, 82, 87 and 114 hp.

hypothesis: Chest+food directive gets past 3:16 on nightmare world.
test: E21 directive only.
learnings: Directive works; survival failed on Bog Toad seed. Later seeds with the same directive lived 17:14 and 15:03.

hypothesis: Daily-style +30 hp jumps do not happen on world in first 3 minutes.
test: List +10 hp without food by 3:00.
learnings: Refute/confirm rules conflict; heal after 3:00 exists on world. 17-20-20 shows +24 at 1:37 and +29 at 1:38 with max hp unchanged, so the absence before 3:00 does not hold. See B18 disproved.

hypothesis: amusing and Colorado Queen put no line on outcome on world.
test: Boss names vs outcome list.
learnings: Amusing can dominate on some seeds only. 17-20-20 amusing at 2:00 and Colorado Queen at 3:03 left no outcome line.

hypothesis: Looser action.dash cuts hp lost 1:00–2:30 versus E21.
test: E24 dash + action.state hurt_by/enemies; same knobs as E21 otherwise. Count dashes and hp 1:00–2:30.
outcome: 17-03: 3:38, ~6 dashes 1:00–2:30. 17-09: 17:14, dashes in window; 18 dashed total.
learnings: Dash spends reliably (confirms B28/B24). Hp in test window much better than E21 on 17-09 but seed has no bog-toad and run became 17m exploit via evolutions; cannot attribute survival to dash alone. 17-20-20 dashed at 78% and 96% during the 1:14-1:20 chest approach and at 85-88% on later bursts.

hypothesis: Evade under 40% keeps directive from burning last hp.
test: Add evade under 40%, ignore far chests.
learnings: 17-18-06 died at 23 hp without under-40 rule; Grater/compost chunks. 17-27-39 died 47→5 hp exploring with queen up. 17-20-20 at 48/192 chose food, which was about 100 away, and died to ice-imp before reaching it.

hypothesis: exploreDistance 600 lists first chest before 1:30.
test: 600 with E21 directive; time of first chest.
outcome: Seed 127B4T9 at exploreDistance 600 listed chests at 1:08, 40 and 54 away, hp 108/120. Four explore goals had each walked 600 units and found nothing (0:10, 0:21, 0:47, 1:07); the 0:47 explore turned aside to a Beetle Nest at 0:52. The 300-unit runs listed the first chest at 1:32, 1:46, 2:16, 2:20 and 3:02.
learnings: The 600-walk was carried out, so this is evidence about the game. The success line (a chest row before 1:30 at high hp) held on one seed. The chests appeared in the list at the 1:08 level-up, after explores that found nothing. One seed is a lead (B37). B25 goes to recheck. Repeat on a second seed before treating 600 as the reason (E39).

hypothesis: Spending gold at Fry Cart/Potato Crate when gold>=100 is worth the walk.
test: planner.state afford shops.
learnings: 17-20-20 bought Coal-Baked Spud at 10:57 (gold 3804 to 3572) and never used it. Boom Spud from 8:03 was also unused at death.

hypothesis: Naming Bog Toad charger in action templates cuts its damage.
test: Template warning; compare bog-toad line.
learnings: No bog-toad line on 17-20-20.

hypothesis: Dash yes follows chosen move and worsens 1:00–2:30 hp.
test: Compare dash count and hp vs E21.
outcome: More dashes, less hp loss 1:00–2:30; no chest in window.
learnings: 17-18-06 adds third seed: better early hp with dashes including 1:47 on chest approach. 17-20-20 dashes at 1:14 and 1:20 went right while the chest was up-left and hp fell 108 to 76, so a dash can still walk off a chest even when the window's total hp looks fine.

hypothesis: No dash while chest still charging avoids 3:24-style failures.
test: Dash no on charging chest; confirm channel completes.
outcome: 3:39, 3 chest opens; 2:27 charge 0.8/1 completed at 58 hp; no dash on charging standing_on; died chasing 4th chest at 47 hp.
learnings: Channel rule partial lead; approach dashes and boss window still cost hp; survival not improved vs shorter runs alone. 17-20-20 showed no dash on a charging standing_on row; the 1:14 dash was on the approach, and the channel fails were step-offs.

hypothesis: ~30 hp heal after 3:00 without food repeats on world.
test: List +10 jumps, no food, no max change after 3:00.
learnings: 17-27 food goal +30 at 3:11; total heal ~67. 17-20-20 also jumped with max hp unchanged and no food goal at 1:37 (+24), 1:38 (+29), 12:25 (+35), 12:49 (+34), 12:54 (+30) and 13:20 (+46). The rise is not only just after 3:00. Outcome health gained about 1033, source unnamed.

hypothesis: Amusing large hits often miss in forecast when standing on/near boss.
test: Per amusing hit >=15 hp: forecast vs on-chest.
learnings: Strong on 17-03-58 at 3:05. 17-20-20 amusing dealt no listed damage. Great Wireworm 56 at 10:03 and The Mandoline 64 and 82 at 12:18 and 12:27 missed the forecast the same way. See E38.

hypothesis: A chest can raise a held weapon ~3 levels without a pick.
test: Levels before/done on chest open.
learnings: 17-03 Peeler jump; 17-18 multiple evolution chests. 17-20-20 chest jumps include Reset Button 2/8 to 7/8 at 1:10, Tater Tot Pup 3/8 to 8/8 at 1:41, Frozen Fries 3/8 to 6/8 at 4:06, Mash Landing 2/8 to 7/8 at 3:25.

hypothesis: The E21 directive + E24 dash stack alone (no further picks) reaches 15:00 on a majority of nightmare world seeds without manual Skip farming.
test: Replicate 17-18-06 loadout policy on 3 seeds; record time and damage mix.
learnings: 17-18-06 lived 17:14. 17-20-20 is a second long sample: 15:03, five evolutions by 8:16, died to ice-imp 773 of 1179. Several other seeds still die before 4:00, so it is not yet a majority.

hypothesis: Naming high-frequency trash (ice-imp, grease-fiend) as burst contact in action.hurt reduces forecast misses on long crowd runs.
test: Add one line to action.state/hurt; compare ice-imp/grease-fiend damage vs 17-18-06 baseline.
learnings: Motivated by 116+75 damage on 17-18-06 with mostly walk routing late. 17-20-20 ice-imp was 773 of 1179 and the killing blow, on page walks at 10:56 (34), 13:47 (87) and 14:19 (114) with enemies_near 0. An action.hurt line is not asked on those steps. Wording alone cannot touch them; see the infrastructure request.

hypothesis: Say no to dash on chest approach when goal is open chest, not yet charging on tile, and hp dropped 5+ in last 3s, to cut 2:20–2:27 approach bleed without abandons.
test: Extend action.dash with goal+hurt_by approach rule; keep E30 charging no; compare hp from first chest list to first open vs 17-27-39.
learnings: Motivated by 17-27-39 dash 79% at 2:23 with amusing still up. 17-20-20, played before that dash wording, dashed at 78% and 96% while approaching a chest at 1:14-1:20 and hp fell 108 to 76.

hypothesis: Great Wireworm and The Mandoline deal 50 hp or more on steps the one-second forecast prices as free, so the action model is never asked.
test: On the next long nightmare world run, list every boss hit of 15 hp or more and mark each row as a page walk or a model move.
learnings: 17-20-20: Great Wireworm 56.4 at 10:03 on a dash rated hurt 0.13; The Mandoline 63.6 at 12:18 from 273 away and 82.3 at 12:27 from 132 away, both page walks.

hypothesis: A second nightmare world seed at exploreDistance 600 still lists a chest before 1:30 while hp is above 80%.
test: Repeat the E26 templates and knobs, including exploreDistance 600. Record the clock and hp of the first chest row, and whether an explore goal walked 600 before it.
learnings: E26 confirmed the clock line on seed 127B4T9 only (1:08, hp 108/120). Seeds differed at exploreDistance 300.

hypothesis: planner.pick takes max HP over crit when the question says a boss within 150 makes max HP stronger, and takes Baked Potato over Skip when the question says to do that under 70% hp.
test: Add those two sentences to planner.pick. Count the shrine pick with a boss within 150, and the Sack of Gold / Baked Potato / Skip picks under and over 70% hp.
learnings: 17-20-20 at 10:02 took crit 6% (75%) over max HP 192 to 215 (19%) with Great Wireworm 94 away, then lost 56 hp. On a full build, Skip won at high hp and Baked Potato won when hp was lower.

hypothesis: planner.state line 'below 25% hp do not start another chest; evade or eat food' prevents 15→1 hp second-chest deaths after a successful open.
test: Add directive line only; same dash templates as E37.
learnings: Motivated by 17-33-44 death on C65851 at 1 hp with hot oil.

hypothesis: Empty action.dash (never dash) on open-chest goals until standing_on shows charging reduces hp lost 50→15 open windows without losing E24 benefit on explore.
test: Dash template: if goal contains Open the chest and not charging, answer 0 always; compare to E37.
learnings: Motivated by 2:49/2:54 dash rows on chest goal despite E37 text.
